title: Tutorial
text:
Overview
This tutorial demonstrates how to use the NEO_Nature package to reproduce the core workflow of the project:

Cleaning and merging Near-Earth Object (NEO) and natural disaster data

Running exploratory analysis to examine potential relationships between asteroid characteristics and disaster occurrence

All analysis in this project is exploratory and does not claim causation.

title: Tutorial
text:
Setup
Before running this tutorial, make sure:

The repository has been cloned locally
Required packages (such as pandas) are installed
The data/ directory contains:

neo_data.csv
disaster_data.csv

title: Tutorial
text:
Running the Cleaning Pipeline
The cleaning pipeline loads the raw datasets, merges them by date, and saves a cleaned dataset for analysis.

from NEO_Nature.cleaning import run_cleaning_pipeline

run_cleaning_pipeline()

This step: - Reads the raw NEO and disaster datasets from data/ - Merges them on the date column - Saves the cleaned dataset to data/merged_neo_disaster_data.csv
You only need to run this step once unless the raw data changes.

title: Tutorial
text:
Running the Analysis Pipeline
After the merged dataset has been created, you can run the analysis pipeline.

from NEO_Nature.analysis import run_analysis_pipeline

run_analysis_pipeline()

This step: - Loads the merged dataset - Aggregates asteroid size and disaster counts by date - Computes correlations for: - Same-day asteroid size vs. disaster count - One-day lagged disaster counts - Hazardous asteroids only - Prints summary statistics and a conservative conclusion
The printed results correspond directly to the findings discussed in the final report.

title: Tutorial
text:
Expected Output
When run successfully, the analysis pipeline will print:

Correlation values for each comparison
A short, plain-language conclusion indicating whether meaningful relationships were detected

These results are intentionally summarized to support reproducibility and clarity.

title: Tutorial
text:
Notes

This tutorial prioritizes reproducibility over visualization
All exploratory plots and deeper investigation were conducted in NEO_eda.ipynb
The package structure allows the full workflow to be rerun without interacting with notebooks

title: Tutorial
text:
Conclusion
By running the cleaning and analysis pipelines shown above, users can fully reproduce the core results of the NEO-Nature project from raw data to final conclusions.

title: NEO-Nature
text:

Documentation describing the package structure and key functions
